limitations: Two fresh spending-change cells provide no verified price/volume, disposable-income, saving or component decomposition.
Retained retail and consumer-credit series cover different quantities. BEA spending estimates may share Census and other underlying inputs, so they are not automatically independent corroboration.

Retained selections are verified tool representations, not original publisher-body hashes. Connected upstream HTTP requests, bytes and redirects are not exposed.

supersedes.reason: Correct current-versus-historical limitations, clarify variables and rounded precision, and remove repetitive/irrelevant prose. No new source acquisition or changed numerical inputs.
